review.finding: All three keep their concept silhouettes and the navy, titanium and amber palette at game-ready size. Tandem: twin hulls, H-frame bridge with the central cabin, and aft nozzles on both hulls. Lantern: glazed forward cabin, side pods and the aft triangular frame. Wayfarer: open C-ring with segmented amber window bands and a three-nozzle engine block. Each mesh is inferred from one 3/4 view, so the far sides, underside and stern are the generator's guess.
